conditions.source: P30E 20 removable sealed AABB modules, shell-body estimate (not physical mounting).

warnings: This is a single-module force envelope (weight times acceleration plus differential pressure force on largest face), not joint FEM, not a true screw pullout or fatigue test.
Pressure differential on opposite faces of one closed module is presumed, deliberately conservative; physical acoustic pressure nearly cancels at low frequency.
Design factor 2 and 2 mounts are hypothetical, not validated certification; torsion/peel and distributed forces omitted.
Mass excludes anchors, seals, paint and any additional foam insert; closed insert construction may change.
Acceleration 1/3/5/10g denotes study loads only, not a certified drop or transportation rating.
Do not select fasteners until adhesive, actual MDF, geometry and measured load paths are evaluated.
